about: A mod's support weapon dropped from a broken hellpod: an EAT-17 copy (register_entity, as the Stratagem Compendium's Expendables are) on a copy of the EAT-17's rack, and the vanilla rack, each under its own stratagem in the loadout on the ship and called in; each rack broken 20 s after it spawns by the game's own rack death (game.dll 0x938650), and the dropped launchers' pickups read: the copy must fall with the EAT-17's pickup on (tests/in-game/README.md). Picking one up by hand is not part of it.

checks.name: the copy, its rack and both stratagems are added
the copy is in its base's armory list, as the game reads it
checks.regex: eat_copy is in armory list 2 \(its base's 2\)

checks.name: both stratagems are in the loadout on the ship
called in, the copy's rack spawns
called in, the EAT-17's rack spawns
the copy's rack holds both copies
the copy's rack breaks (by the probe, or by itself first)
checks.regex: PROBE copy (break ok|rack broke by itself: rack [0-9]+ left)

checks.name: the dropped EAT-17s can be picked up
the dropped copies can be picked up as the EAT-17s
